## The generator

`kind: diverse_comb` (`src/data_processing/rotor_spectral_model.py`,
`DiverseCombNoisePool`), configured by `conf/online_mix/rp_combdiv.yaml`. One
window, $M = 8$ microphones, $R = 4$ rotors:

$$
x_m(t) \;=\; \sum_{\rho=1}^{R} g_{m\rho}\,\Big(\frac{r_\rho(t)}{80}\Big)^{2.5}
\sum_{k=1}^{K} a_{\rho k}\,\cos\!\big(k\,\phi_\rho(t) + \psi_{\rho k}\big)
\;+\; \sigma_m\, n_m(t),
\qquad \phi_\rho(t) = 2\pi\!\int_0^t r_\rho ,
$$

with $r_\rho$ the label (rev/s), $n_m$ independent unit white noise per
microphone, $\psi_{\rho k}$ uniform phases, $g_{m\rho}$ uniform on
$[-4, 0]$ dB, $K = 500$ orders (the comb reaches Nyquist down to 16 rev/s)
faded out over the top 10 % of the band. Every
quantity below is drawn **once per window** and held constant inside it. The
lines go through the noise model's line kernel (`noise_model.render`, the
renderer of the `prior` streams): each line a complex envelope on a 1 kHz grid
(level, phase, speed law, band-top fade) on the carrier $k\phi_\rho$ at 16 kHz.

**Line levels** (power, dB): two power laws, odd under even,

$$
20\log_{10} a_{\rho k} \;=\; G_\rho \;+\;
\begin{cases}
-S_\rho \log_{10} k & k \text{ even} \\[2pt]
-P_\rho - (S_\rho + \Delta_\rho)\log_{10} k & k \text{ odd}
\end{cases}
\;+\; \varepsilon_{\rho k},
\qquad
\varepsilon_{\rho k} = \operatorname{clip}_{\pm 30\,\text{dB}}\!\big(s_\rho\, t_{3}\big),
$$

and line $k$ is **dropped** ($a_{\rho k} = 0$) with probability $p_\rho$.
The Student-$t_3$ departure is heavy-tailed: at $s = 4$ dB about 6 % of the
lines leave their law by more than 12 dB and 1.5 % by more than 20 dB.

**Floor.** A line is *buried* when it stands under the white floor in a
2048-point Hann spectrogram (128 ms, the campaign's analysis window): its power
$a^2/2$ at the microphone is below the floor's power inside one bin,
$3\sigma_m^2/2048$. Compared with the floor's *total* variance $\sigma_m^2$
instead, a "buried" line would still stand $10\log_{10}(2048/3) = 28$ dB over
the floor on screen, so nothing would ever disappear. $\sigma_m$ is the largest
value at which no rotor loses more than a fraction $f$ of its counted lines
(kept, below Nyquist at the rotor's window-median speed), so the most buried
rotor at each microphone loses $\lfloor f n\rfloor / n$ of them and the
others fewer.

| draw | range | anchor (`docs/experiments/static-rig-profiles.md`) |
|---|---|---|
| even slope $S_\rho$ | U(10, 30) dB/decade | measured 25 ± 5 |
| odd penalty $P_\rho$ | U(3, 20) dB | measured 8–9 ± 9 |
| extra odd slope $\Delta_\rho$ | U(0, 5) dB/decade | ≥ 0: odd law under even law everywhere; measured penalty barely grows from k = 3 to 30 |
| line scatter $s_\rho$ | U(2, 5) dB, $t_3$, clipped ± 30 dB | measured 3.5–5.6 dB (Gaussian fits) |
| drop probability $p_\rho$ | U(0, 0.3) | — |
| rotor level $G_\rho$ | U(−4, +4) dB | measured rotors 2.3–5.2 dB apart |
| buried share $f$ | U(0, 0.9) | — |

**Trajectory.** `rps.kind: fitted_traj`: a posterior drone per flight at hover
U[35, 95] rev/s, `rotor_sep` [2, 15], `rps_max` 150, measurement process off,
`shrink: {rigs: [dregon, michaels], weight: 0.57}` (`rps-trajectory-model.md`
§ "Reduced hyperprior"). Take-off and landing are raised-cosine ramps of
0.6–1.6 s and 0.25–0.8 s (`rps.phases`; the scaffold default is 1.5–4 and
1.5–4.5 s): peak rotor-mean slew 43 / 69 / 110 rev/s² at take-off and
80 / 128 / 210 at landing (p10 / p50 / p90, 100 flights), against 61–115 and
70–390 measured on DREGON room 2 and M100-class flights. Training renders 32
random **4 s** windows from each flight, ground and idle phases included, and
cuts 40 random **2 s** windows from each render (`render_reuse: 40`,
`render_duration_s: 4.0`, as in the `prior` stream); the draws below are
**6 s** windows, one per flight, so each is a fresh drone.

## Draws

Ten consecutive draws (seed 20261022), microphone 0, every clip played at the
same RMS (training draws the level log-uniform on 0.02–0.25 instead). Left:
spectrogram, 2048-point Hann, 70 dB range; middle: the bottom 1.5 kHz; right:
each rotor's lines over the floor in the same 2048-point spectrogram at this
microphone — points under the dashed line are buried. Below: the labels.
Second row: the drawn profile of each rotor as a line spectrum over harmonic
order, in the same units — dark stems even orders, light stems odd orders,
grey crosses dropped lines at the level they were drawn at; the solid and
dotted curves are the even and odd power laws the lines were drawn around;
the dashed line is the burial threshold.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

here = Path("diverse-comb")
index = json.loads((here / "index.json").read_text())


def rotor_table(item):
    rows = [
        "| rotor | median rev/s | even slope | odd penalty | odd slope | scatter | drop p | level | buried (mic 0) |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for r, (p, v, b) in enumerate(zip(item["rotors"], item["median_rps"], item["buried_mic0"])):
        rows.append(
            f"| {r + 1} | {v:.1f} | {p['even_slope_db']:.1f} dB/dec | {p['odd_penalty_db']:.1f} dB "
            f"| {p['odd_slope_db']:.1f} dB/dec | {p['scatter_db']:.1f} dB | {p['drop_prob']:.2f} "
            f"| {p['gain_db']:+.1f} dB | {b:.0%} |"
        )
    return "\n".join(rows)


def show(item, heading):
    print(f"\n### {heading}\n")
    print(f"![]({here.name}/{item['slug']}.png)\n")
    print(f"![]({here.name}/{item['slug']}_profiles.png)\n")
    print(f'<audio controls preload="none" src="{here.name}/{item["slug"]}.wav"></audio>\n')
    print(f"Buried share drawn: **{item['subsumed']:.0%}** (most buried rotor).\n")
    print(rotor_table(item) + "\n")


for i, item in enumerate(i for i in index if i["kind"] == "draw"):
    show(item, f"Draw {i + 1}")
```

## Take-off and landing

Take-off and landing fill a few percent of a flight, so ten random windows
rarely catch one. These are the first take-off and the first landing among
further random windows of the same stream (seed 20261023), drawn exactly as
above.

```{python}
#| output: asis
for item in (i for i in index if i["kind"] == "ramp"):
    show(item, item["label"].capitalize())
```
